column1: # Serbian, Cyrillic script (sr) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format
# as es.tsv: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Transliterated letter for letter from sr-latn.tsv (the CFA4 Serbian Latin catalog), so both
# scripts say the same thing; change a wording in both files. Product, format, codec and key names
# (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL, H.264, Shift…) and placeholders stay in Latin. Clean-room like
# sr-latn.tsv: no proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or
# copied. Quotation marks are „…“; decimal comma (0,5). A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = клип, track = трака, sequence = секвенца, timeline = временска линија,
# bin = фасцикла, playhead = глава за репродукцију, marker = маркер, In/Out point = улазна/излазна
# тачка, keyframe = кључни кадар, frame = кадар, caption = титл, preset = предложак,
# template = шаблон, workspace = радни простор, gain = појачање, opacity = непрозирност,
# render = рендеровати, ripple = таласасто, dissolve = претапање, wipe = брисање,
# voice-over = нарација, proxy = прокси, (Legacy) = (застарело).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see sr.tsv.attribution.
